clips.title: The story
paras: Heralath Fallowbrook lies dying in Razorfen Kraul, with one last plea for the living. He asks that his wife's stolen pendant reach Darnassus, along with word of his death.

In Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook lies mortally wounded among the brambles. The stronghold is overrun by savage quilboar and dark magic, far from Alliance territory. With his strength fading, Heralath manages only broken whispers. He says a brave dwarf named Lonebrow was sent ahead to warn Falfindel. Heralath knows he will not leave the Kraul alive.

Heralath's last wish is to recover the pendant that marks his marriage to Treshala Fallowbrook. One of the lair's aggressors tore it from him. He asks any traveler who stops beside him to carry it across Kalimdor to Darnassus, so Treshala learns of his death instead of waiting in vain.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have not long to live... So... So... Weak.
...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...
...my wife, Treshala... Her pendant of bonding to me... Stolen... By one of the f-f-foul aggressors...
Find it p-p-please... And return it to Treshala in Darnassus...
...along with w-w-word of my lonely... Death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to my home, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: 'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!
I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.
You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, friend. But please leave me now.
